messages:
lisa: Quick flag for the KPI sync  our weekly dashboard shows a weird attribution shift: direct traffic RSVPs up 45% but CRM shows source=partner for many of them. Can @omar check mapping & cohort export?

omar: Will do. Quick check: looks like the event landing page appends partner query param `ref=partnerX` but GA landing attribution sometimes attributes to direct if UTM missing. Pulling a CSV of last 7 days now.

maria: If mapping mismatch is the cause, that will bias our launch benchmarks for CPL and QL. We need a short note for the review explaining the discrepancy and proposed fix.

omar: SQL I used: ```select landing_page, count(*) as rsvps, coalesce(utm_source,'direct') as source from form_submissions where event='launch_webinar' and submitted_at between '2026-03-01' and '2026-03-07' group by landing_page, source;``` Export: https://dash.redwood.ai/s/exports/1759998888.csv

lisa: Thanks. Ops ask: set a small attribution patch  if ref param present and utm_source is null, map to `partner`. Omar can you add that to the CRM ingestion rules and note it in the KPI slide?

omar: Yep. I'll add a one-line mapping rule and re-run the cohort calc. Will post a short blurb for the KPI slide: cause, impact (% shift), and fix.

—dashbot: Snapshot: https://dash.redwood.ai/s/weekly/kpi/1759998888  includes cohort table + source parity note.

—maria: Perfect. KPI review at 9:30am — Omar please attach the corrected cohort and a 1-paragraph comms sentence we can drop into the launch postmortem.
